class.name: CameraFrame
class.brief_description: An immutable camera frame snapshot with capture metadata.
class.description: Contains an image copied from a completed camera frame and the metadata associated with that capture. Compare [member frame_id] when polling [method CameraFeed.get_latest_frame] to avoid processing the same frame more than once.

members.member: The physical position of the camera that produced the frame.
Device orientation at capture time. Only valid when [member orientation_available] is [code]true[/code].
Monotonically increasing identifier supplied by the camera backend.
Image data owned by this snapshot.
Whether [member device_orientation] contains synchronized motion data.
